entities.summary: Herrenvolk democracy is a partially democratic form of government in which only a specific ethnic group has voting rights and the right to run for office, while other groups are disenfranchised. Herrenvolk democracy is a subtype of ethnocracy, which refers to any form of government where one ethnic group dominates the state, with or without elections. Elections are generally free, but voting suffrage was restricted based on race, with governance that reflected the interests of the politically dominant racial group.
